label: NOT_EVIDENCE_POWER_SENSITIVITY
provenance_caveat: Power sensitivity projections from observed base rates. NOT performance evidence. Poisson independence is an approximation; cross-venue pooling (scenario c) is NOT Hyperliquid evidence and is an upper bound on independent information.

scenarios.note: Observed retained-window episode rate extended to the full 283-day spec window at the same 24 symbols; no new symbols, no new venues.
Same rate/universe held for 2 years of calendar time (beyond the API retention horizon, so operator archive required).

Hyperliquid observed rate plus OKX observed episode rate pooled over the same 283-day window. CROSS-VENUE: not Hyperliquid evidence; pooling assumes independence across venues, which shared market crashes violate, so this is an upper bound on independent information.

rate_sensitivity.basis: traded-episode rate is estimated from 2 events; +/-50% band shown

interpretation: Even the most favourable achievable scenario stays well below even odds of reaching the >=10 independent-episode floor. The 283-day spec window at the observed rate cannot reach the floor; only a multi-year archive or a materially higher episode rate can, and the pooled cross-venue scenario is an upper bound, not evidence.
